Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
OK.. so the old Sela we know and love has this ability:
If Sela becomes an archbishop, each ready bishop controlled by your prey
burns 1 blood.

Advanced Sela is an Archbishop.

So, if you have basic Sela in play, and then you merge her, her ability
triggers, because she "becomes" an Archbishop. Correct?

But if you have Advanced Sela in play, and then you merge her, her ability
does not trigger, because she doesn't "become" an Archbishop, she already
is one. Correct?

Also, if, for example, Constanza Vinti is in play, and you merge Sela
as the first example above, does her ability trigger? Does she "become an
Archbishop" before her title contests?

Does she "become an Archbishop" each time a vampire contesting her title
yields?

they will contest. From the rulebook:
"4.2. Contested Titles
Some titles are unique. For example, there can be only one prince
or archbishop of a particular city (see “Vampire Sects,” sec. 10)."

"The title of prince is associated with
a particular city and can be contested by another vampire who
claims the title of prince or archbishop of the same city."

> "The title of prince is associated with
> a particular city and can be contested by another vampire who
> claims the title of prince or archbishop of the same city."

<nit>Barons also contest cities. And barons must pay an extra blood to
contest a prince or archbishop.</nit>

--Colin McGuigan
